counterhypotheses.claim: Generative VLM/mmproj token features are optimized as language-model inputs, not as calibrated global instance/open-set embeddings. A dedicated retrieval/embedding objective may be necessary.
counterhypotheses.evidence: Qwen's official Qwen3-VL-Embedding stack builds a separately trained retrieval model on the Qwen3-VL foundation and obtains the final normalized embedding from the multimodal model's last hidden state, rather than simply declaring raw visual projector tokens to be retrieval embeddings.

counterhypotheses.claim: Even a good prototype space can become invalid when runtime/preprocessing/backend geometry changes, producing false familiarity or false unknown decisions without weight changes.
A small dedicated encoder may still be Pareto-superior if it avoids expensive Qwen vision execution on frames that only need familiarity checks, despite duplicating representation machinery.
counterhypotheses.decision_rule: Keep isolated only if measured total path cost plus open-set quality beats same-encode reuse under target workload.

counterhypotheses.claim: Exposing pre-merger internals in the target runtime may create a brittle fork/API maintenance burden larger than its accuracy benefit.
Aggressive unchanged/ROI gating can suppress small but action-critical GUI changes.
counterhypotheses.required_test: Pixel/ROI metamorphic suite with cursor-independent tiny text, icon-state, dialog, permission, checkbox, badge and focus changes plus action-critical periodic/uncertainty anchors.
